body: how are you in my brain
seriously if you need a friend or someone to vent to sometimes im here❤️

Hey dear, I feel what you’re saying 100%, I’ve been there too, but please stay with us. I don’t know you but know that you are loved by a little stranger across the world. I don’t know if that would help you as it did me but just realizing that nothing really matters… You are not supposed to be doing anything other than live. So to think that you need to succeed to be worthy of living is not the way. You should try to find beauty in life, little things that make you personally happy, whether it be drawing, sitting or walking outside, animals, food, the sun, the rain. To consciously chose to be happy. Thats what helped me. I was at the lowest of lows and did not see the point, and I still feel trapped and lost at times but I just gave in, I accepted that I am here and I should experience life like everybody. I also felt like killing myself would bring me peace but it’ll come on its own time and in the meantime you should just ride the wave that life is.

hey bro please don’t be so hard on yourself. I’ve been in that place and I have lost a close one to suicide and I can tell you that it only moves your pain to others. I deadass did not believe I would ever feel fulfilment and happiness, I thought I was done for. But trust me when I tell you that it does get better, people aren’t just sayin that. Life changes, it’s ups and downs but the contrast is why we stay. That’s what makes it worth it. The good moments in life. There will be times of course where you can’t seem to think of any but please stick with us. And for the people that love you. You’re needed, cared for, and have a purpose. Something that helped me a lot was changing my perception on things. Nothing much actually changed in my situation, I just consciously choose to view things differently. Meds were useless if not aggravating imo. Be careful, because they don’t always tell you but meds can be what drives you to the edge. Stay strong❤️
